user.title: GeoPulse
user.description: Choose which devices are archived and which people are visible to administrators only. Trackers are editable and fully archived; family members are admin-only but are archived too.

data.geocode: Look up addresses for unknown places
data.enabled: Store location history in the local archive
data.recorder_backfill_days: Days of recorder history to backfill
data.poi_sync: Keep a local OpenStreetMap place index

data_description.trackers: Devices whose full location history is stored in the local archive. These timelines are editable and survive after the recorder deletes old data.
data_description.family: Additional people visible to administrators only. Their points are archived too, but regular users do not see these timelines. Do not add your own phone here if it is already listed under Trackers.
data_description.geocode: Looks up an address for unknown places via Photon/Nominatim. This sends coordinates to an external service; disable it to keep everything local.
data_description.enabled: Stores every location report in /config/HA_timeline/archive.db, independent of the recorder retention. Disable this if you only want the recorder timeline via source: ha_history; importing, exporting and editing then stop working.
data_description.recorder_backfill_days: Number of days of still-available recorder history copied into the archive at startup. 0 disables it. The recorder usually keeps about 10 days.
data_description.contacts_file: Optional path to a .vcf contacts file. Leave empty for the default /config/HA_timeline/contacts.vcf; if it does not exist, contacts are skipped. The file is read locally.
data_description.poi_sync: Keeps a local index of OpenStreetMap places (shops, businesses, addresses) for fast search and the 75 m nearby list. The index is refreshed nightly via Overpass.

error.unknown_entity: One or more selected entities no longer exist.

abort.yaml_configured: GeoPulse is configured through configuration.yaml. Remove that block before using the UI.
